name: Micro Finance Scheme (GNDTDC)
benefit: **Loan Amount Details:** - **Loan Amount:** Up to ₹1,25,000/-.- **Interest Rate:** 5% per annum. - **Loan Contribution:** 90% will be from the National Corporation, 5% from the State Government, 5% from the beneficiary.- **Repayment:** The loan amount will have to be repaid in 48 equal monthly installments, including interest.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to the Nomadic Tribe or Denotified Tribe. 1. The applicant's family's annual income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-. 1. The applicant's age should be between 21 to 50 years on the date of application. 1. The applicant should have experience & technical skill in the proposed trade/business. 1. The applicant will have to provide suitable collateral to get the loan. **Note:** At least 50% of the total loan amount under this scheme will be specifically allocated to families with an annual income of up to ₹1,50,000/-.
